sources.full: Chaos at the Food Court: Modern Earth

adventure.name: Chaos at the Food Court: Modern Earth
adventure.author: Offscreen Worlds, adapted from the 2019 C2E2 premise

entries.name: Adventure in Brief
entries: Four level-8 adventurers investigating strange lights at Thornwatch cross through a cinema screen into a modern shopping mall. Bombeldo's crystal projector opened nine secondary rifts. The adventurers must break the nine living planar links to stabilize the screen and return home. The Hydra occupies West Mall; the remaining monsters are in East Mall.

Young Red Dragon guards a new hoard inside Coronet Jewelers. Eddie Vale's attempted robbery draws the dragon into the food court if he succeeds. West and East are 450 feet apart along a normal enclosed shopping concourse.

entries.name: What Happened
entries: Bombeldo Trask, owner of The Dungeoneer beside ThunderCube in EAST Mall, bought an antique crystal projector at an estate sale. His tests caused strange lights and humming near Thornwatch's stone arch. He brought it to the WEST cinema for a promotional screening, switched it on, and fled back to his shop when it overloaded.

The projector beam struck the screen, joining it to Thornwatch's arch. The party entered through this primary doorway. Secondary breaches released one Hydra, one Bulette, two Displacer Beasts, one Gelatinous Cube, one Spectator, two Owlbears, and a Young Red Dragon. All nine monsters were already in the mall when the party arrived.

Each living secondary-rift creature maintains a planar link while inside the mall building or on its roof. Death, travel off-plane, or crossing the outer walls to the outdoors disconnects it. If a living monster reenters the building, its link immediately returns. Unconscious monsters remain linked. The adventurers crossed through the cinema screen, so they do not carry links.

Nine violet strands glow inside the crystal, one per active link. A strand goes out when its monster disconnects. Turning the crystal reveals the general direction of each linked monster. DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) identifies the resonant feedback; the strands themselves are plainly visible.

STOP halts the projector's electrical motor but cannot extinguish the magical beam while any link remains. With zero links, STOP opens the cinema screen to Thornwatch for 60 seconds. An intact projector can be restarted and stopped to open another window. Shattering the crystal destroys this controlled way home.

The dragon has settled in Coronet Jewelers, guarding jewelry as its hoard. Two Owlbears are feeding in separate secured kitchen/service areas. They are not allies of the dragon or the other displaced monsters.

Eddie Vale is an ordinary shopper. When the food-court violence distracts everyone, he tries to steal a tray of watches through Coronet's smashed window. If the dragon sees its stolen treasure leaving the store, it follows Eddie to recover the hoard. If the robbery is prevented, it stays until its territory is threatened.

entries.name: Table Coordinates and Pieces
entries: WEST folding map: 22×26 squares; cinema booth C3–E4, security P3–U9, fountain I12–O18. EAST rolled map: 34×22 squares; The Dungeoneer M2–U7 beside ThunderCube, Coronet X2–AG8, kitchens and food court. A1 is upper left; 5 feet per square.

entries.caption: DM placements, columns A-AH
rows: In hoard; reacts to robbery or intrusion

entries.name: Player and DM PNG Images
entries: WEST and EAST are connected by 450 feet of enclosed retail corridor, 30 feet wide with ordinary fire doors and turns. West connects at V12–V16 to East at A10–C14.
WEST: Cinema east entrance, booth door into theater, and west-side security door are marked. Fountain water is shallow difficult terrain for creatures without Swim Speed; its rim may grant cover.

EAST: The Dungeoneer is beside ThunderCube. The Cube begins outside the west kitchen doorway (M19–N20); Owlbear O1 starts behind a jammed service shutter (G19–H20). Coronet's broken south frontage at AB8–AD8 opens into the food court. The atrium ceiling is 35 feet; balconies are 15 feet high.

Glass storefronts AC 13, 10 HP per 5-foot panel. Tables and cases provide half cover when they obstruct attacks. Bulette's crater is difficult terrain. Exterior parking and sidewalks are outside the planar-link boundary; the rooftop is inside.

entries.name: Thornwatch (0:00–0:05)
entries: The reeve hired the party to investigate violet lights, low humming, and odd reflections around the old stone waystation near Thornwatch.

READ ALOUD: The road to Thornwatch winds through dark pines. For three nights, locals have reported violet lights and a low hum near the abandoned waystation. Ahead, an old stone arch gleams faintly in the still air.
Faint scorch lines cross the arch; puddles sometimes reflect an unfamiliar ceiling. DC 13 Arcana reveals planar instability. The characters have time for introductions and a first action.

READ ALOUD: A deep note hums through the stones. Violet light fills the arch. Your reflections lag a heartbeat. The ground drops away, and the smell of pine becomes butter, sugar, and popcorn. Your boots strike red carpet before an enormous moving picture.
The pulse draws the nearby party through to the West cinema together, carrying their gear and magical abilities.

entries.name: The Cinema
entries: READ ALOUD: Rows of padded chairs face a wall-sized moving image. A child points at your weapons and asks, 'Are you in the movie?' A crash shakes the building; screams follow from the concourse.

Mel Ruiz, a cinema usher, is pinned under a fallen curtain bar (DC 13 Athletics, two people lifting, or suitable magic). Mel saw Bombeldo install the projector and heard a many-headed creature outside.

Projector in CINEMA BOOTH C3–E4, reached through the door at the rear of the theater. STOP shuts off the motor but the violet beam persists while monster links remain. Nine strands are visible within the crystal; DC 13 Intelligence (Arcana) explains the resonance. Rotating the crystal shows the general directions of surviving links.

entries.name: Encounter 1: Hydra
entries: READ ALOUD: Five reptilian heads sweep above a shattered fountain rim. The enormous creature thrashes in the water as shoppers flee between overturned kiosks.
WEST L13–N15: Hydra (184 HP), already in the fountain I12–O18. It pursues armed threats into the walkway. On death, a violet arc fades and one projector strand goes dark.
{@creature Hydra|XMM}

entries.name: Dana Torres and the Concourse
entries: Dana Torres manages mall security in WEST. Her cameras recorded a violet blast from the cinema booth, creatures appearing across the building, and a red reptilian shape entering Coronet Jewelers in EAST. She cannot explain the magic.

Dana knows Bombeldo sponsored the screening and fled to The Dungeoneer, beside ThunderCube in EAST. She has camera footage, a service-pass key and evacuation routes. The East food court lies 450 feet along the enclosed shopping concourse.

entries.name: Encounter 2: Food-Court Menagerie
entries: READ ALOUD: Six-legged black panthers flicker between abandoned tables. A floating eye surveys the room from above, while a nearly transparent wall of jelly slides out of the kitchen. Cracks spread across the tiled floor.

EAST: Spectator M10 (15 feet aloft); Displacer Beasts N12–O13 and U10–V11; Gelatinous Cube M19–N20 outside the kitchen. The Bulette is already burrowing under Q17–R18 and emerges at round 2 start, or earlier if discovered or disturbed, taking its turn on its initiative.

The Bulette's emergence ruptures a sprinkler pipe and sounds the kitchen fire alarm. Both Owlbears were eating food supplies behind jammed steel service shutters; the noise draws them toward the exits. The shutters have AC 19 and 100 HP each. The Owlbears begin attacking their shutters when the Bulette erupts. They can break through during a long fight or afterward; the characters can open or break a shutter sooner.

The Cube is in the dining area, outside Owlbear O1's kitchen. Owlbear O1 begins at G19–H20, Owlbear O2 at AC19–AD20; both stay in their rooms until they break through or a door is opened. Tables provide cover where they obstruct attacks. Bulette's crater is difficult terrain.
{@creature Bulette|XMM}; {@creature Displacer Beast|XMM}; {@creature Gelatinous Cube|XMM}; {@creature Spectator|XMM}

entries.name: East Mall Between Battles
entries: Coronet Jewelers X2–AG8: dragon starts Z4–AA5 guarding jewelry and watches. Bombeldo is hiding at The Dungeoneer M2–U7. Eddie Vale is near AB10, watching the smashed jeweler's window.

The Owlbears start battering their jammed shutters after the Bulette emerges and continue until an exit is open. An undisturbed service corridor can accommodate a one-hour short rest; all surviving creatures continue their activities.

entries.caption: Eddie's attempted theft
colLabels: Party present in the food court
rows: If Owlbears emerge into combat, Eddie enters the shop and tries to take a jewelry tray. The dragon notices the theft and joins initiative on its normal count.
After the area quiets, Eddie approaches after roughly five minutes. He takes the tray if not stopped. The dragon pursues when it sees its treasure carried away.
Eddie can be stopped, and the dragon can be confronted inside the store at any time.
After an hour, the dragon has either recovered the jewelry and returned to Coronet or remains investigating the disturbance. Eddie has fled or been caught; he is not guaranteed to survive.

entries.name: Encounter 3: Owlbears and Dragon
entries: EAST: Owlbears emerge from jammed shutters once they force an exit (O1 G19–H20, O2 AC19–AD20). They seek food and react to nearby threats. Eddie attempts his theft if he believes the area is distracted.

READ ALOUD (if Eddie succeeds): A man runs from the shattered jewelry storefront clutching a velvet tray of watches. From the darkness behind him a voice bellows, 'THIEF!' A red dragon crashes through the opening and follows the glittering loot into the food court.

Young Red Dragon (178 HP, Fire immunity, DC 17 Dexterity, 16d6 Fire breath) starts Z4–AA5 in Coronet. It exits through the broken south storefront at AB8–AD8 when the theft or another threat to its treasure provokes it. Roll initiative when it becomes involved; it acts on its regular count, with no free attack.

The dragon wants its jewelry returned. It may pursue Eddie, threaten armed strangers, attack, or retreat to guard its hoard once the treasure is recovered. If Eddie is intercepted, the dragon remains inside unless another threat draws it out.
An hour later the dragon's location follows its actual pursuit and return to the store, not a fixed pose. It has not automatically killed or allied with either Owlbear.
{@creature Young Red Dragon|XMM}; {@creature Owlbear|XMM}

entries.name: The Projector and the Return
entries: Projector in WEST cinema booth C3–E4. Motor and STOP lever function normally, but its crystal projects while linked living monsters remain inside the mall. Nine glowing strands show active links; rotating the crystal gives a direction to each remaining creature.

entries.caption: Crystal feedback
rows: Linked monster alive inside the building or on its roof
Its link glows. STOP halts only the motor; the screen remains unstable.
Linked monster dies, travels off-plane, or exits the exterior walls
Its link darkens. Reentering alive, or returning from banishment inside the mall, immediately reconnects.
Final active link ends with STOP already selected
A doorway back to Thornwatch opens in the cinema screen for 60 seconds, even if the party is in East Mall.
Final link ends while motor is RUNNING
Pull STOP to open the screen portal for 60 seconds.
The party arrives after the one-minute window
With no links active, cycle RUN then STOP again to reopen the doorway for another minute.
A linked creature reenters while portal is open
The returning link collapses the portal. The doorway can be reopened once all links are inactive.
No controlled doorway. Independent planar travel remains possible; motor or housing damage can be repaired.

entries: RETURN READ ALOUD: The screen flickers behind you. A moment later the air smells of pine again, and the Thornwatch arch stands beside the road. Its violet marks fade to ordinary gray stone.
